purpose: repair the bounded student development runner after a pre-training CLI startup failure

prior_failure.error: Namespace object had no validation_dataset attribute
prior_failure.cost_interpretation: imports, CUDA availability, four input hashes, and train-only stats parsing completed; dataset construction and model training did not start

repair_scope: record phase transitions, completed optimizer steps, elapsed time, checkpoint state, and tracked new disk bytes in success and failure artifacts
enforce the 1200-second wall budget across all stages with in-process guards and SIGALRM on Linux
enforce the 15 GiB new-output budget before and after tracked stages
force the supplied train-only normalization statistics into both loaded datasets
require a 50x24 action mask with exactly the first 7 dimensions active
use the real model.predict_action(actions_gt=None) to reach the action-head get_action ODE and report seven-dimensional denormalized MAE/MSE
retain only initial and final validation ODE passes with the same recorded noise seed; do not run a final pass2

execution_contract.gpu_policy: GPU2 only after a fresh preflight confirms no compute process and <=1 GiB persistent use
execution_contract.source_datasets: reuse QC-passed seed42 train and seed43 validation bundles; do not recapture or overwrite

stop_conditions: source, QC, loader, or train-only statistics hash mismatch
claim_boundary: development_only_same_task_seed_holdout; no object generalization; no closed loop; no formal promotion
